_readme: Vorlagen für die Kartenbilder. Wer die Bilder neu erzeugen oder einzelne
Werte austauschen will, ändert hier den Text und ruft dann auf:
FAL_KEY=… node tools/generate-art.mjs            # alle fehlenden Werte
FAL_KEY=… node tools/generate-art.mjs 3 7 --force # nur diese, neu
Der Stilblock steht bewusst im system_prompt und nicht in den einzelnen
Prompts: nur so sehen alle 14 Karten wie aus einer Hand gezeichnet aus.
Zahl und Kraftname legt die Oberfläche später über das Bild – deshalb
darf im Bild selbst weder Text noch Rahmen auftauchen.
Die Rückseite wird absichtlich nicht generiert, sondern in css/style.css
als Muster gezeichnet: exakt, verlustfrei und ohne zusätzliche Datei.

output.note: Karten werden höchstens rund 190 CSS-Pixel breit gezeichnet; 600 px reichen damit auch auf Bildschirmen mit dreifacher Pixeldichte.

system_prompt:
You are illustrating a single deck of 14 cards for a family card game. Every image you produce must look like it came from the same illustrator on the same afternoon. Hold this art direction fixed for every request:

STYLE: flat vector illustration, mid-century childrens-book look, bold simplified shapes, uniform thin dark outlines of even weight, a fine even paper grain over the whole image.
COLOUR: exactly four to six flat colours per image, chosen from a warm retro palette. Flat colour fills only.
FORBIDDEN: no drop shadows, no 3D bevel or embossing, no glossy highlights, no vignette, no photorealism, no smooth airbrush gradients.
FRAME: full-bleed poster illustration. The artwork reaches all four edges of the canvas. There is no card border, no white margin, no frame, no rounded corners, no passe-partout.
CONTENT: no text, no numbers, no letters, no signature, no watermark, no logo anywhere in the image.
COMPOSITION: one clear subject, centred, filling most of the frame, on a single flat background colour.

0.prompt: A white unicorn seen in profile with a golden spiral horn and a pastel rainbow mane, resting on a soft cloud under a deep night sky with a crescent moon and a few drifting seed pods, a wide rainbow arcing across the lower third. Palette: deep navy, cream, pastel lilac, soft pink, gold.

1.prompt: A cluster of fireflies with softly glowing pale-gold abdomens drifting above tall grass stalks and two closed flower buds at night. Palette: midnight teal, warm cream, soft gold, pale mint.

2.prompt: Three large butterflies with boldly patterned wings hovering around a single open flower, their flight paths drawn as thin looping lines. Palette: sage green, cream, dusty rose, soft coral, pale teal.

3.prompt: Two plump frogs sitting on round lily pads on still water, one mid-leap above the other, with a few reeds and ripple rings. Palette: moss green, cream, olive, soft yellow, teal.

4.prompt: Several small birds perched among the layered leaves of a stylised tree, wings folded, arranged across the branches like cut paper shapes. Palette: teal green, cream, soft orange, olive, plum.

5.prompt: A curled sleeping fox with a thick brush tail wrapped around itself, a second fox peering out from behind a low bush of simple leaf shapes. Palette: warm ochre, cream, burnt orange, olive green, dark brown.

6.prompt: A ring of small grey mice arranged radially around a wooden mousetrap holding a wedge of cheese in the centre, all seen from directly above. Palette: golden yellow, cream, warm grey, soft brown, dark plum.

7.prompt: Three owls sitting side by side on a bare branch, wide round eyes staring straight ahead, one with a single eye winking shut. Palette: amber, cream, deep brown, olive, dusky purple.

8.prompt: Two long snakes coiling around each other in a symmetrical knot, flat scale patterning along their bodies, forked tongues out. Palette: mustard, cream, teal, rust, dark brown.

9.prompt: A sleek cat crouching low and peering around the corner of a wall, only its head, one paw and the tip of its tail visible, eyes wide. Palette: burnt orange, cream, deep teal, charcoal, dusty pink.

10.prompt: Three ravens perched on a leaning fence post, heads turned in different directions as if watching something, a few loose feathers falling. Palette: dark plum, cream, orange, slate grey, deep blue.

11.prompt: Two pointy-eared goblins with mischievous grins swapping a small sack behind their backs, one glancing sideways. Palette: rust red, cream, olive, dark brown, ochre.

12.prompt: A hoarding dragon curled tightly around a heap of coins and cups, wings folded over the pile, one eye open and watchful. Palette: deep crimson, cream, ember orange, charcoal, gold.

13.prompt: A menacing three-headed hellhound with glowing amber eyes and smoking breath, crouching on jagged black rocks with small licking flames around its paws. Palette: charcoal black, deep crimson, burnt orange, bone white.
